findings.suggestion: 7 short units; distinguish complete sentences, dialogue and deliberate emphasis before editing.
findings.why: Several very short units may interrupt the argument.
findings.fix: Check which units are complete sentences and which fragments need connection.
findings.keep_when: Keep dialogue, slogans, instructions and deliberate emphasis.

findings.suggestion: Short-unit annotation; a complete short sentence or a deliberate fragment can be appropriate.

findings.keep_when: Keep complete short sentences, dialogue and a single punchy fragment.

findings.suggestion: Consider a comma, period, or parentheses where appropriate.
findings.why: Many interruptions can obscure a sentence’s main connection.
findings.fix: Consider a period, comma or parentheses where the connection becomes clearer.
findings.keep_when: Keep a list separator, quoted dash or deliberate interruption when it aids reading.
